name: ML-SUPERB 2023
description: The 2023 Multilingual Speech Universal Performance Benchmark (ML-SUPERB) Challenge expands upon the acclaimed SUPERB framework, emphasizing self-supervised models in multilingual speech recognition and language identification. The challenge comprises a research track focused on applying ML-SUPERB to specific multilingual subjects, a Challenge Track for model submissions, and a New Language Track where language resource researchers can contribute and evaluate their low-resource language data in the context of the latest progress in multilingual speech recognition. The challenge garnered 12 model submissions and 54 language corpora, resulting in a comprehensive benchmark encompassing 154 languages. The findings indicate that merely scaling models is not the definitive solution for multilingual speech tasks, and a variety of speech/voice types present significant challenges in multilingual speech processing.
evaluation_method: composite_score (aggregation of task-specific metrics such as WER for ASR, accuracy for LID, EER for speaker tasks, etc.)
reputation: Well-regarded in the multilingual speech community as a comprehensive probe of self‑supervised models across many languages, with growing adoption for multilingual ASR/LID research.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; task-specific metrics vary (e.g., WER vs. accuracy); language imbalance and under-representation of many low-resource varieties can bias aggregate scores; potential dataset/domain mismatch across speech/voice types.
